title: Inspiration: 1st Day Of Eid
body:
..."Ya Kareem", it is enough. Fatiha can grasp & throw the world like this. We don't know, we
don't know our situation. We don't know about our situation. And it says, "Don't read Fatiha for
dunya". Say "I leave it to the Ashab al-Nawba."
Read one Surat al-Ikhlas, making niyah for it to be a spiritual power for us. This is the new
instruction. This is the Azamat/Greatness, AzamatAllah. Aman ya Rabbi, tawba ya Rabbi. It is
not even a small bit for the whole world, even if whole world gathered & said it. What we want is,
put all your effort for the Divine Word of Allah. Raise the flag, say, speak, have no fear. No one
can destroy you. And for those who come to you, say "I leave it to Ashab al-Nawba". Bismillahi
r-Rahmani r-Rahim. Tell them "Read 7 Basmala Sharif & go". That is it.
It is astonishing. Now there is a change in tajalli, Hj Mehmet. It is astonishing. I am ashamed,
ashamed, ashamed.. I am ashamed to say "Make me get up, run..". How can I say? O
Rasulullah, O Habibullah.. Dunya, dunya... Allah Almighty makes this dunya sit on an atom.
Allah is Qadir al-Muqtadir. Not just the world but this universe of ours, Allah Almighty can
make it sit on an atom. Al-Muqtadiru.

When GrandShaykh was telling me the meanings from Asma al Husna, he stopped at alMuqtadir. He didn't say, he couldn't say. What is the simplest expression for it? AlHamdulillah
now an expression has come- The One who has such a Power that can make a billion universes
like ours sit on an atom. Allahu Akbarul Akbar, Ya Rabbi! There is no limit for Your Greatness.
Tawba Ya Rabbi, tawba Astaghfirullah.
O my Lord, O my Lord, thanks to You. The waridat/inspiration is strong, Hj Mehmet. It comes
to your heart also. Say it & write it down also. Subhanim Allah Sultanim Allah. Nabim
Muhammad Alayhi Salam. Fatiha for Umm Haram Sultan. The inspirations are very strong, Sh
Mehmet. Be careful &, also record what is coming inside. Say it. Say or write it down, as you like.
Have no fear.
Allah Allah.. Allah, Allah, Allah. Allah, Allah. Subhanak Ya Rabbi. How beautiful is our Lord.
And what have we seen from His Beauty? If even an atom came from His Beauty, an astonishing
beauty fills the universe Astonishing! Allah Allah.. Allahu Akbar. Awliyas now have fallen into an
ocean of astonishment because of the opening/futuhat, Hj Mehmet. Allah..
I am ashamed to say "give strength for my hands, for my feet.." I am ashamed. They are saying
from upstairs "Is this the purpose? Are we going to deal with your hands, feet?" I say, to erect the
flag of Islam, the flag of Heavens.. I am a person in the state of weakness. Fatiha.
If one of the Holy ones kicked this world with his feet, he can throw it from its orbit to a distance
which has no end. Allahu Akbarul Akbar. Allahu Akbarul Akbar. Allah! If a waliyyullah (saint)
touched it like this.. May Allah forgive us. Forgive us O Lord. Fatiha. Shukur Ya Rabbi, Shukur.
An futuhat/opening like for the Sahib al-Zaman never opened before - Mahdi (as), Allahu
Akbar.
The people were happy here. They got happy. (greeting from the window)
S.M. It was a complete festival.
M. We couldn't have done this in the mosque. How beautiful it was. I also got happy. Actually I
was happy too. We can't go out of the "human" attribute. Attributes that belong to man are

dressed on us, servanthood attribute is dressed. Therefore we can't go beyond this. We are
helpless. The One Who is Qadir al-Muqtadir is our Lord. But He will open now. What is the gift
for the Eid is coming from the 1st Heaven, for the Eid. He will open, will open Sham al-Sharif
now. He is a strong one, from the Ishraqiyyun, Adnan al-Tahir Hz. Allahu Akbarul Akbar. And
for us too, for us too... Ya Rabbi.. Allah shukur, Allah shukur...
